templates.sql: SELECT c.id AS candidate_id, TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(c.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(c.last_name, ''))) AS candidate_name, CASE WHEN c.nova_id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('https://nova.ayahealthcare.com/#/recruiting/candidates/', c.nova_id, '/new-profile/about') END AS nova_url, SCORE(c.search_tokens, 'Dietitian') AS relevance, CASE WHEN c.latitude IS NULL OR c.longitude IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (2 * 3958.7613 * ASIN(SQRT(POW(SIN((c.latitude - @lat) * 3.141592653589793 / 360), 2) + COS(c.latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * COS(@lat * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * POW(SIN((c.longitude - @lng) * 3.141592653589793 / 360), 2)))) END AS miles FROM hc_candidates@{FORCE_INDEX=hc_CandidatesSearchIndex} AS c WHERE SEARCH(c.search_tokens, 'Dietitian') AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (c.latitude IS NULL OR c.longitude IS NULL OR (2 * 3958.7613 * ASIN(SQRT(POW(SIN((c.latitude - @lat) * 3.141592653589793 / 360), 2) + COS(c.latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * COS(@lat * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * POW(SIN((c.longitude - @lng) * 3.141592653589793 / 360), 2)))) <= @radiusMiles) ORDER BY CASE WHEN miles IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, miles ASC, candidate_name ASC LIMIT 10
templates.intent: Find active candidates by specialty within a geographic radius around a named place.
templates.manifest: Find active candidates in a specialty near a given city. Coordinates are optional: return NULL miles for ungeocoded candidates, keep them eligible, and sort known distances before NULL distances.

parameterized.parameterized_intent: Find active $1 candidates near $3 with optional $2-mile radius filtering for rows that have coordinates
parameterized.parameterized_sql: SELECT c.id AS candidate_id, TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(c.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(c.last_name, ''))) AS candidate_name, CASE WHEN c.nova_id IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('https://nova.ayahealthcare.com/#/recruiting/candidates/', c.nova_id, '/new-profile/about') END AS nova_url, SCORE(c.search_tokens, $1) AS relevance, CASE WHEN c.latitude IS NULL OR c.longitude IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (2 * 3958.7613 * ASIN(SQRT(POW(SIN((c.latitude - $3) * 3.141592653589793 / 360), 2) + COS(c.latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * COS($3 * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * POW(SIN((c.longitude - $4) * 3.141592653589793 / 360), 2)))) END AS miles FROM hc_candidates@{FORCE_INDEX=hc_CandidatesSearchIndex} AS c WHERE SEARCH(c.search_tokens, $1) AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (c.latitude IS NULL OR c.longitude IS NULL OR (2 * 3958.7613 * ASIN(SQRT(POW(SIN((c.latitude - $3) * 3.141592653589793 / 360), 2) + COS(c.latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * COS($3 * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * POW(SIN((c.longitude - $4) * 3.141592653589793 / 360), 2)))) <= $2) ORDER BY CASE WHEN miles IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, miles ASC, candidate_name ASC LIMIT 10

value_searches.query: SELECT $value AS value, 'hc_candidates.specialty,hc_candidates.sub_specialty,hc_candidates.profession,hc_candidates.search_tokens' AS columns, 'Specialty' AS concept_type, 0 AS distance, '{}' AS context FROM hc_candidates AS c WHERE LOWER(c.specialty) = LOWER($value) OR LOWER(c.sub_specialty) = LOWER($value) OR LOWER(c.profession) = LOWER($value) LIMIT 10
value_searches.description: Exact specialty/profession match against canonical hc_candidates. Required value searches: Dietitian, DIET, DietSrv, RN, Registered Nurse, MS, MS/Tele, ER, ICU Nurse, RESP, RRT, Respiratory Therapy, Respiratory Therapist, CT Tech, X-Ray Tech, Pharmacy Tech Inpatient, PHM, Surgical Services, Sterile Processing Tech (SPT), CNA, LAB.

value_searches.query: SELECT $value AS value, 'hc_candidates.status' AS columns, 'Candidate Status' AS concept_type, 0 AS distance, '{}' AS context FROM hc_candidates AS c WHERE LOWER(c.status) = LOWER($value) LIMIT 10
value_searches.description: Candidate status values on hc_candidates. The active recruiter-facing value is ACTIVE.

value_searches.query: SELECT $value AS value, 'Packages.specialty,Packages.profession' AS columns, 'Package Specialty' AS concept_type, 0 AS distance, '{}' AS context FROM Packages AS p WHERE LOWER(p.specialty) = LOWER($value) OR LOWER(p.profession) = LOWER($value) LIMIT 10
value_searches.description: Package specialty and profession values used when a natural language request references a job or package.
